An ecological statistician job opening in Scotland that may be of interest to this community

-----Original Message-----
From: On Behalf Of Ken Newman
Sent: 18 February 2021 06:07
Subject: Ecological & Environmental Statistician post in Scotland

Biomathematics & Statistics Scotland (BioSS) is looking to fill a newly created position of Ecological & Environmental Statistician.

This is an exciting opportunity to participate in the development of and application of statistical methodology to ecological and environmental problems, with primary focus on impacts of offshore renewable energy on marine mammals and seabirds.

Please feel free to share the attached announcement and position details with others who might be interested.

The closing date for applications is 9th March 2021.

Ken

--
Biomathematics and Statistics Scotland (BioSS) is formally part of The James Hutton Institute (JHI), a registered Scottish charity No. SC041796 and a company limited by guarantee No. SC374831
